mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, reducing mexiletine metabolism and increasing its serum concentrations, which may lead to toxicity including cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor mexiletine levels and cardiac function closely; consider alternative antibiotic or reduce mexiletine dose; watch for signs of mexiletine toxicity (tremor, dizziness, palpitations).
